proposalConstraints: Freeze exact production roots src/cli/entrypoint.ts and src/domain/index.ts.
Use dependency-cruiser 18.2.0 only for src graph extraction; do not use orphan=true as the dead-node rule.
Freeze bounded local-src reachability semantics and fail on every src module outside the production-root closure.
Include connected dead-subgraph and test-only-reference counterexamples.
Keep quality:entropy independent, small, deterministic, and read-only.
Do not add Knip or a home-grown unused-package scanner.
Keep unused dependencies/exports/types deferred or excluded.
Do not add baseline/waiver/cache/changed-file planning, registry/platform, automatic cleanup, or new lifecycle state.
